result.response:
The bug has been fixed and verified.

### Cause of Bug
1. When parsing selector groups separated by `,`, [`QueryParser.parse`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jsoup_21_group_d_fix/src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/QueryParser.java#L58-L65) previously split the remaining query by calling `tq.chompTo(",")`. This caused commas nested inside regexes or attribute queries (such as `:matches([0-9,]+)`) to be mistakenly treated as top-level group delimiters, truncating expressions and causing `PatternSyntaxException`.
2. Handling comma separation via `chompTo(",")` interfered with structural combinators in selector lists. Treating `,` directly as a combinator in [`QueryParser.combinator`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jsoup_21_group_d_fix/src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/QueryParser.java#L81-L103) ensures that selector groups and structural combinators parse in proper sequence.

### Solution
- Added a no-argument constructor to [`CombiningEvaluator.Or`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jsoup_21_group_d_fix/src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/CombiningEvaluator.java#L64-L66).
- Removed the ad-hoc `tq.chompTo(",")` loop from [`QueryParser.parse`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jsoup_21_group_d_fix/src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/QueryParser.java#L58-L65) and handled `,` as a combinator in [`QueryParser.combinator`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jsoup_21_group_d_fix/src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/QueryParser.java#L98-L110).
- Generated [`enlightened_fix.patch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jsoup_21_group_d_fix/enlightened_fix.patch) containing only source code modifications.
- Verified that all scenarios in `CucumberTest` pass.
